KNOW ALL PERSONS BY THESE PRESENTS that, Braid on Myers and Heather
Myers, husband and wife ("Grantor"), whose address is 5420 Dell Range Boulevard, Cheyenne,

good and valuable consideration, receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged by
and between the parties, does hereby grant to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming a municipal
corporation("City"), whose addressis 2101O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming82001, and to
("Ease ment Area") attached hereto and incorporated herein.
RECITALS
WHEREAS, the City desires to obtain a temporary construction easement for the
the DELL RANGE/VAN BUREN AVENUE IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT, including, butnot
limited to, the space necessary for the operation and storage of equipment and the movement of a
work force, over, upon and across the described easement, together with the right of ingress and
egress;
WHEREAS, the Grantor states that it is the lawful owner of the real property described
herein that it has good and lawful right and authority to grant, sell, and convey said property, or
any part thereof, and that it warrants the title of said property;
WHEREAS, the Grantor iswilling to grant such a temporary construction easement to
Grantee on and subject to the terms and conditions of this agreement; and
WHEREAS, the Grantee agrees to surrender possession of the premises upon completion
of the project, and to leave the premises in substantially the same or better condition thanit was
on the date this easement was executed. However, it is understood that grading changes may
exist upon completion of theproject.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing premises and the mutual
agreement of the parties hereto, theparties herebyagree asfollows:
1.Temporary Construction Agreement.Grantor executes this in favor of City, its
successors and assigns, the right and privilege to a temporary construction easement in the
Easement Area for the purposes of locating, constructing, improving, and completing other
necessary work as part of the DELL RANGE/VAN BUREN AVENUE IMPROVEMENTS
PROJECT, including, but not limited to, the space necessary for the operation and storage of
equipment and the movement of a work force, over, upon and across the described casement.
Such grant includes all rights and privileges necessary or convenient for thefull enjoyment and
use thereof for the above-mentioned purposes including, but not limited to, the right of ingress
and egress over Grantor's adjoining property to exercise the explicit and implicit rights granted
hereinby this agreement.

2.Modification.The Grantor shall be prohibited from altering or placing anything
in the Ease ment Area which shall obstruct or impede the City's temporary use of the areafor the
purpose of construction.
3.Duration. This Temporary Construction Easement shall commence upon the
date it was executed and shall automatically expire one(1) yearfrom the date rendered hereof or
upon completion of the above referenced project, whichever event is the latest to occur.
4.Shared Use.The Grantor reserves the right to make any use of the Easement
Area which is not inconsistent with the rights herein conveyed to the City, and which does not
interfere with the aforementioned purposes of the construction of theDELL RANGE/VAN
BUREN AVENUE IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT by the City.
It is understood and agreed that the enforcement and conditions of this agreement, and all
rights contained herein, shall be strictly reserved to the Grantor and the City.Nothing contained
express intention of the Grantor and the City that any such person or entity, other than the
Grantor or the City, that receives a service or benefit under this agreement shall be deemed an
incidental third-party beneficiary only.
This grant of the Easement Area is binding upon the heirs, executors, administrators,
successors, and assigns of the parties hereto.
